tezera vendor web portal - wireframe prototype (21 Oct 2026)

Open index.html in any browser. Every page works offline and links to the others.
Fonts (Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Sans) load from Google Fonts when online.

Pages: index (dashboard), Auth, Feed, Event, Community, Messages, Notifications,
Requests, Jobs, Stalls, Bookings, Booking, MyStall, Payments, Profile, Reviews,
Verification, Settings.

canvas-source/ holds the original design-canvas files for this version.
